description.en: A rare and curious creature, he always packs with treasures.
description.zh: 罕见且稀奇的生物，经常带着一些宝物。

chat.en: The rare and wondrous Yeti carries his lunch box up and down Mount Brainer to his isolated mountain lodge.
chat.zh: 罕见而奇妙的雪人提着午餐盒，在脑山上下往返，前往他那与世隔绝的山间小屋。

text.en: runs away after a short while
text.zh: 进场一段时间后就撤离
